messages:
Maya: Heads up — bringing up q8b-rerank candidate today. Need fresh promptset that covers multi-turn rerank cases + dedupe plan. Anyone on curation?
Shawn: on it. can we reuse the q6b-rerank bank or do we need fresh samples for quant artifacts?
Maya: reuse as seed but we need additional edge-case pairs where top-2 are close. Also ones that highlight hallucination rerank swaps.
Eli: I can export the q6b bank and run fingerprint overlap. sending sample counts in a sec.
labeler-bot: export complete: 9,812 pairs. preview link: https://internal/redwood/curation/preview/1768888888
Shawn: nice. I'll run de-dupe pass with fuzzyhash threshold 0.84 and flag paraphrase pairs for manual review.
Tara: FYI, labeling team capacity this week is low (max 400 pairs/day). If we need golden re-labels we might need to prioritize.
Maya: okay prioritize: 1) near-equal-ranked swaps, 2) hallucination-led swaps, 3) long-context (>2048) prompts. Rest can be sampling for baseline.
Jordan: For quant experiments, we also need the same promptset run on float32 baseline and int8/q4b quant. I'll queue runs on staging.
Eli: quick dedupe command I'm using:
```bash
curate dedupe --input q6b_rerank.json --strategy fuzzyhash --threshold 0.84 --emit-flagged paraphrase.json
```
Shawn: thanks. after dedupe I'll produce `micro-golden-200` with highest disagreement samples for labelers.
Tara: label guidelines updated (short): prefer fidelity to human truth, mark 'rank swap reason' tags: [relevance, halluc, format, length]. Link: https://go/docs/labels
Maya: can we tag which samples are affected by KV-cache behavior in q8b? need to know if long-context mismatch is infra or model.
Eli: I'll add `kv_risk:true` metadata for >2048 prompt windows after we run tokenization pass.
Jordan: experimental plan: run float32 (baseline) -> q4b -> q8b -> quant-int8. Collect per-sample perplexity, rerank delta, and token-alloc cost. Should finish ~6 hours.
Shawn: putting a canary label job: 200 pairs to be double-labeled for inter-annotator agreement. Tara please assign when micro-golden done.
Tara: assigned. ETA for labeling start: tomorrow 10am PST. Will surface if capacity shifts.
Maya: great. after label results, we'll run evaluation harness and generate `regression-report.md` and attach to the model onboarding PR.
ops-bot: deploy job queued: rerank-staging-cluster: job-45321. status: queued :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Eli: FYI I found 312 near-duplicates that look like tokenization variants (unicode vs ascii). I'll canonicalize and re-run dedupe.
Shawn: cool — leave a note in the micro-golden manifest about canonicalization.
Maya: thanks all. check back here if any blockers. :thumbsup:
Jordan: ping me if rerank CI fails — I can rollback to q4b autoscale config.
labeler-bot: micro-golden-200 created: https://internal/redwood/curation/micro/1768888888 - contains metadata fields: kv_risk, token_len, source_model
Tara: closing loop: will post labeling summary in #eng-ml tomorrow after first batch.
Maya: ack. we'll aim for canary rollout end of week.
